gripOrHq.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

gripOrHq.title: The Shell Traders
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

gripOrHq.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

ice.title: Fetch 4.0.1
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
